title: Week's best: Kindle £119.99, Ninja Dual Zone £119.99 and Ring doorbell bundle £39.99
description: This week's strongest UK deals as Amazon's Black Friday Week gets going: new Kindle £119.99, Ninja Dual Zone £119.99, Ring bundle £39.99.
intro:
**The pick of the week is the new Amazon Kindle at £119.99, £30 off, and the Ninja Foodi Dual Zone air fryer at £119.99, £80 off.** Amazon's Black Friday Week began on 19 November and runs to Cyber Monday on 30 November, so most of this week's best prices are now at Amazon. The Ring doorbell and indoor camera bundle is still £39.99, the Roborock Qrevo S Pro robot vacuum is down to £319.99, and the Ninja CREAMi soft-serve maker is £289. For gifts, the Philips OneBlade 360 is £39.99 and the Lego Gingerbread House is £28.

This roundup only includes deals we could re-check on sources dated 19 November (TechRadar's and T3's live deal blogs), so a few earlier picks are left out because we couldn't confirm they're still live. Check the product page before you buy. Buy now or wait? Amazon's own devices (Kindle, Ring, Fire TV) are usually at their lowest for the whole sale, so there's little point waiting. Big kitchen and floorcare buys could still dip on Black Friday itself, 27 November.

deals.name: Amazon Kindle (newest model)
deals.note: The basic Kindle with a sharp, glare-free screen and weeks of battery. TechRadar expects this to be its lowest price until at least next year's Prime Day. Pair it with a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](/guides/kindle-unlimited-free-trial-uk/), and see our [Kindle Black Friday guide](/guides/kindle-black-friday-deals-2026/) for the Paperwhite and Colorsoft.

deals.name: Ninja Foodi 6-in-1 Dual Zone air fryer
deals.note: Two drawers that cook different foods at once and finish together, big enough for a family. £80 off is about as low as this model goes. Compare it in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ring Battery Video Doorbell + Ring Indoor Camera bundle
deals.note: Still the best-value smart home deal of the sale: a wire-free doorbell and an indoor camera for less than the doorbell usually costs on its own. The 'was' price adds the two list prices together. More in our [Ring doorbell Black Friday guide](/guides/ring-doorbell-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Roborock Qrevo S Pro robot vacuum and mop
deals.note: Vacuums and mops, then empties itself and washes its mop pads at the dock, so you only need to touch it every few weeks. £230 off makes it a mid-range price for a near top-end robot.

deals.name: Ninja CREAMi soft-serve ice cream maker
deals.note: The CREAMi that also pipes soft serve, a fun family gift. It's a pricey treat even at £60 off, so if you only want scoopable ice cream, the standard models in our [Ninja CREAMi deals guide](/guides/ninja-creami-deals-uk/) cost far less.

deals.name: Philips Hue Festavia string lights, 20m
deals.note: App-controlled Christmas tree lights with colour gradients and effects. They usually sell for £149 or more, and T3 reports an extra on-page voucher at Amazon, so check for it at the checkout. Only worth it if you already have, or want, Hue at home.

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one flexible blade, and it's kind to sensitive skin. Holding at £39.99 all week, which makes it an easy gift for anyone with stubble. More ideas in our [Christmas gifts for Dad guide](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-dad-2026/).

deals.name: Revlon One-Step hair dryer and volumiser
deals.note: Dries and adds volume in one go, so it's a good budget alternative to a Dyson Airwrap. TechRadar says £25 is a record low. Use the Amazon link below to check whether Amazon is matching it.

deals.name: LEGO Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A Christmas build that doubles as a decoration year after year. 20% off is a fair price for a seasonal set. See our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) for bigger sets.

deals.name: Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K Max (newest model)
deals.note: The fastest Fire TV Stick, with Wi-Fi 6E. If you just need 4K streaming, the Fire TV Stick 4K Select was £21.99 on the same day. Our [Fire TV Stick deals guide](/guides/fire-tv-stick-deals-uk/) compares them.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Black Friday itself is a week today, on 27 November, and Amazon's sale carries on to Cyber Monday on 30 November. Amazon devices and the Ring bundle are already at sale lows, so buy those now if you want them. Larger kitchen gadgets and robot vacuums sometimes see a second cut on Black Friday, but popular models can sell out, so don't hold out for much more than another £10 to £20.

Many Amazon deals don't need Prime, but members get some extra prices and free fast delivery. A [30-day Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) started now covers Black Friday, Cyber Monday and most Christmas orders. Our [Amazon Black Friday 2026 guide](/guides/amazon-black-friday-2026-uk/) has the dates and tips, and [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/) lists every retailer's sale.

## This week: Black Friday kitchen deals

The Ninja Dual Zone and CREAMi are both in this week's spotlight category. Our [Black Friday kitchen deals 2026 spotlight](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/) shows what to buy now, what to wait for and the prices worth paying.
